upsert.title: Builder.io Agent-Native Hackathon
upsert.summary: Build a working app with the Agent-Native framework and submit a public Clips demo video and demo link. Free to enter; no registration needed to build or submit.
upsert.eligibility: Developers worldwide aged 18+ (or age of majority), solo or teams, subject to applicable laws and sanctions; sponsor employees and judges cannot win.
notes: Winners announced 6 Nov. Payment subject to identity verification and tax forms.

upsert.title: SoSoValue: Build Your One-Person On-Chain Finance Business
upsert.summary: Online buildathon to create on-chain finance tools using SoSoValue data, news feeds, index tools, trading APIs and the ValueChain L1. Judged on user value, working demo, workflow design, API integration and UX.
upsert.deadlineLabel: Closes 30 Oct (time and timezone not stated)
upsert.eligibility: Not stated on the aggregator page; confirm on the AKINDO event page.

prize.description: 10,000 USDC total (no per-place breakdown published on the listing).

notes: Verified via the HackList detail page only; official AKINDO page could not be opened in this run.

upsert.title: Blockscout PRO API Buildathon
upsert.summary: Two-sprint online buildathon to build dApps with the Blockscout PRO API at the core. Mentorship, certificates and badges for participants.
upsert.deadlineLabel: Listed deadline 3 Nov (timezone not stated); Sprint 2 runs 25-31 Oct
upsert.eligibility: Squads of 1 to 4 people; no other requirements listed.

prize.description: 1,200 USDC awarded in Sprint 2 (no per-place breakdown published).

notes: Verified via the HackList detail page only; sprint year and exact cutoff should be confirmed on the Craftora page.

upsert.title: Portaldot Hacker House 2026
upsert.summary: Online DoraHacks hackathon building on Portaldot Network V3.0 (WASM and EVM) across four tracks: modular cloud and middleware, cross-chain infrastructure, node tooling and ecosystem dApps. Projects must deploy on the Portaldot testnet.
upsert.eligibility: No team-size or geographic limits listed on the aggregator page; confirm on DoraHacks.

prize.description: 5,200 USDT total: 2,600 USDT cash plus 2,600 USDT equivalent paid in POT tokens.

notes: Only about half of the pool is stated as USDT cash; the rest is POT tokens. Verified via the HackList detail page only.

upsert.title: Total Recall: Tatum x Walrus Memory Hackathon
upsert.summary: Global online hackathon to build on Walrus Memory (mainnet) with Tatum AI Builder or RPCs, across three tracks. Open to AI and Web3 projects.
upsert.eligibility: Not stated on the aggregator page; confirm on the Tatum event page.

prize.description: US$4,500 total: three tracks at US$1,000 each plus bonuses.

notes: Verified via the HackList detail page only; official page could not be opened in this run.

upsert.title: AI Builder Hackathon 2026 (Victoria VR)
upsert.summary: Online hackathon to build browser-based AI-native 3D experiences that turn natural language into 3D scenes and working logic. Any web-based 3D stack allowed; topics include AI-generated scenes, intelligent NPCs and procedural worlds.
upsert.eligibility: Not specified on the aggregator page; confirm in the official announcement.

prize.description: EUR 20,000 total (no per-place breakdown published; confirm cash form in the announcement).

notes: Verified via the HackList detail page only; USD figure is an approximate conversion.
